facts.fact: Standard Bank Eswatini says its Unayo wallet has over 200,000 registered retail customers and about 5,000 business clients, and will close on 31 December 2026.
Standard Bank Eswatini says customers can send and receive payments in real time between participating bank accounts and wallets, 24 hours a day.
The article says the Eswatini Payment Switch connects banks and non-bank payment providers, with real-time transfers between bank accounts and wallets in service.
